description: Speeds a WAV up or slows it down (0.25–4×), keeping the pitch (time-stretch) or letting it follow the speed, and returns MP3 or WAV. MP3 and other compressed input needs the web page, which decodes in the browser. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The audio as base64: a PCM WAV file (8/16/24/32-bit integer or 32/64-bit float, any channel count). MP3, M4A and other compressed formats need the web page, which decodes them in the browser.

format.description: Output format: MP3 (192 kbps) or 16-bit WAV.

keepPitch.description: true: time-stretch (WSOLA), so voices and notes keep their pitch. false: resample, so the pitch moves with the speed like a record played fast or slow (2× is an octave up).

name.description: The source filename. The result is named <stem>-<speed>x.mp3 or .wav.

speed.description: Playback speed, 0.25–4. 2 is twice as fast (half as long), 0.5 half as fast (twice as long).

name: change_audio_speed
title: Change Audio Speed
